title: branch-2.13 package builds go through dev/build.sh; dev/build.py only delegates
answers: how are mlflow 2.13 packages built for release?
where does the python.yml release workflow build mlflow-skinny on branch-2.13?
why does dev/build.py just call dev/build.sh?
which pyproject file does mlflow-skinny use on the 2.13 branch?
body:
- Release packaging on branch-2.13 is done by dev/build.sh, not by the v3+ dev/build.py logic.
- dev/build.py:main is a shim: it accepts --package-type {release,skinny} (the mlflow/releases python.yml CLI) and runs `bash dev/build.sh`, adding `--skinny` for skinny.
- mlflow is built from pyproject.toml; mlflow-skinny from pyproject.skinny.toml (both via dev/build.sh).
- The shim exists so the build matches how 2.13.x shipped. Change package build behaviour in dev/build.sh, not in the shim.
- dev/build.py is dev/CI-only and is not included in the shipped mlflow or mlflow-skinny packages.
applies: Only the branch-2.13 release line; v3+ branches use their own dev/build.py.
says: Release packaging modifications on the 2.13 maintenance branch are not taking effect.
The skinny package build on the 2.13 release pipeline uses incorrect project configurations.
Update package build scripts on the 2.13 branch to match release requirements.
Changes to the build Python script are ignored during 2.13 release workflow runs.
Support building both standard and skinny distribution packages in 2.13 maintenance releases.
search: Release packaging on branch-2.13 executes through dev/build.sh, with dev/build.py:main acting solely as a delegating CLI shim. The shim accepts --package-type {release,skinny} from the python.yml release workflow and runs bash dev/build.sh, which builds mlflow from pyproject.toml and mlflow-skinny from pyproject.skinny.toml. Package build modifications belong in dev/build.sh rather than the shim, which is restricted to development and CI on branch-2.13 and excluded from shipped packages.
